newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait crown prince returns to hospital for tests.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait crown prince returns to hospital for tests.

text.p: Kuwait's crown prince returned to hospital on Friday for further tests and newspapers said he might fly on Saturday to Britain for treatment.
Sheikh Saad al-Abdulla al-Sabah, born 1930, left hospital on Thursday saying he was in "good health" after fainting on Tuesday evening. He returned to hospital on Friday.
Al-Seyassah daily said Sheikh Saad, crown prince and prime minister since 1978, would leave for Britain on Saturday on board a hospital aircraft supplied by neighbouring Saudi Arabia.
Kuwait's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah visited the crown prince on Friday at hospital while several regional leaders telephoned to inquire about his health.
There has been no official explanation of Sheikh Saad's sudden illness but Western diplomats say the crown prince fainted on Tuesday due to bleeding in the colon.
"I am, thank God, in good health," Sheikh Saad said on Thursday as he left hospital.
